generation.prefix_processing: fresh full prefill for every physical query

purpose: Separate oracle evidence sufficiency from functional necessity of directly attending its SET leaf. Fix the prior partial-record control weakness without another load search, cohort, architecture or training run.
baseline: Reuse all2688sealed full-history readouts and original336queries/model. The earlier oracle sufficiency audit remains separate context, never relabeled necessity.
support_leaf: Backward executable evidence_slice for each own-world query; remove from question/answer historical attention only the WHOLE original token span of its earliest SET event. All other records, prelude, original prefix computation and positions remain. Require a unique earliest SET leaf and show removing it from the symbolic evidence slice makes the queried truth undefined or different.
matched_control: Choose a WHOLE SET event outside the evidence slice, writing an entity absent from the read/write entities of every evidence event. Its original token-span length must exactly equal the support leaf. Minimize absolute token-center distance to the support leaf, tie-break by original event index. Remove only this record historical KV access on question/answer rows. Keep all other records and every prefix update. Do not assume contextualized non-support KV is devoid of answer information.
data_checks: Same48existing cases/8base streams, all336physical prompts/432bindings permodel, all roles/variants/depths/wordings/before. Actual tokenizer offsets must partition every whole event without crossing events or prelude; no partial records. Two masks suppress equal counts at nearby positions and retain the rest of history. No candidate chosen by model output. Freeze all masks and sources before inference.

safety.smoke: First and last original cases, every3variant/3role binding:18physical queries permodel/regime,288newreadouts. No performance threshold; independent complete smoke audit before5376fullreadouts.
safety.sample_queries: Existing6current-target safety IDs plus protected/initial queries for firstcase control and lastcase treatment:10distinct physical IDs permodel. Both regimes sampled, including cached generation.
safety.prefix_proof: Each sample: actual unmasked readout exactly replays source and all-history mask preserves full cache/bookkeeping/logits/readout. Each whole-record removal regime preserves complete ledger-prefix KV/recurrent/conv/bookkeeping and last-prefix logits, plus all12historical K/V tensor slices during full-question prefill. Actual six-layer softmax observation must show exactly zero suppressed probability/mass and nonzero kept-record access, with nonzero unmasked controls.
safety.other_checks: All newreadouts must exercise prefill and cached masks, with hook cleanup. Both question-only models preserve6distinct native prefixes each. After everyarm detach,10native exact replays. Pin source snapshots, checkpoint files, generation config, native full loaded-state hash and frozen unchanged adapter tensors.

analysis.unit: 8reused base_case_id streams; depths, wordings, variants and roles are related, no independent sample or significance claim.
analysis.coverage: Report full/remove-support/remove-other scores for every model, role, order, depth, wording and before baseline. Paired remove-other versus remove-support current-after losses AND rescues, all8streams and3depths.
analysis.necessity_gate: For EACH of local_question and gdn_question_only: remove-other must have no lower current/history/unrelated-after counts and before_all_correct cases than full; remove-other versus remove-support must show positive signed current-after loss overall AND in at least4distinct base streams. BOTHmodels required. This is a descriptive necessity screen, not architecture success or proof of a unique causal route.
analysis.if_passed: Whole-record direct evidence access matters relative to a nearby equal-token, irrelevant-event removal under these frozen models. This does not establish semantic write damage or show that a shared controller is necessary.
analysis.if_failed: No support-leaf/control/threshold/checkpoint tuning, other leaf or layer search, new load hunting or automatic architecture training. Contextualized KV may carry the value elsewhere; lack of an individual-leaf effect does not imply lack of all evidence use. Preserve the sufficiency result separately.
analysis.preserved_negatives: Prior shared/history/repeat primaries remain failed. New control does not replace the prior zero-scoring partial-record control or retroactively change any gate.

scope: Frozen dense-eager mask necessity diagnostic on reused COPY data, not a practical sparse implementation, trained router, absence-of-information test, natural-prefix intervention or new architecture. No new models, environments, downloads or training. Original semantic-dependency coordination goal remains open.
